economy.summary: His campaign platform calls for delivering economic justice through good union jobs and strong labor standards, and funding frequent, reliable, and affordable public transit.
economy.short: Calls for union jobs, labor standards, funding public transit.

taxes.summary: His platform calls for making corporations and the ultra wealthy pay their fair share by closing loopholes, and investing in progressive taxation to fund public services.
taxes.short: Calls for corporations, ultra wealthy to pay fair share.

education.summary: His campaign platform states he was elected to fully fund public schools.
education.short: Platform says he was elected to fully fund public schools.

healthcare.summary: His platform calls for guaranteeing healthcare as a human right, not a privilege.
healthcare.short: Calls to guarantee healthcare as a human right.

guns.summary: His public safety platform focuses on funding community-based violence prevention along with parks, libraries, and neighborhood programs, and expanding juvenile diversion and restorative justice; the campaign issues page does not detail gun-law positions.
guns.short: Focuses on community violence prevention; no gun-law specifics stated.
